passages.label: Prop. 3.22.43
passages.text: spes et venturae coniugis aptus amor.

passages.label: Prop. 3.23.1
passages.text: Ergo tam doctae nobis periere tabellae,

passages.label: Prop. 3.23.2
passages.text: scripta quibus pariter tot periere bona!

passages.label: Prop. 3.23.3
passages.text: has quondam nostris manibus detriverat usus,

passages.label: Prop. 3.23.4
passages.text: qui non signatas iussit habere fidem.

passages.label: Prop. 3.23.5
passages.text: illae iam sine me norant placare puellas,

passages.label: Prop. 3.23.6
passages.text: et quaedam sine me verba diserta loqui.

passages.label: Prop. 3.23.7
passages.text: non illas fixum caras effecerat aurum:

passages.label: Prop. 3.23.8
passages.text: vulgari buxo sordida cera fuit.

passages.label: Prop. 3.23.9
passages.text: qualescumque mihi semper mansere fideles,

passages.label: Prop. 3.23.10
passages.text: semper et effectus promeruere bonos.

passages.label: Prop. 3.23.11
passages.text: forsitan haec illis fuerunt mandata tabellis:

passages.label: Prop. 3.23.12
passages.text: 'irascor, quoniam's, lente, moratus heri.

passages.label: Prop. 3.23.13
passages.text: an tibi nescio quae visast formosior? an tu

passages.label: Prop. 3.23.14
passages.text: non bona de nobis crimina ficta iacis?'

passages.label: Prop. 3.23.15
passages.text: aut dixit: 'venies hodie, cessabimus una:

passages.label: Prop. 3.23.16
passages.text: hospitium tota nocte paravit Amor,'

passages.label: Prop. 3.23.17
passages.text: et quaecumque volens reperit non stulta puella

passages.label: Prop. 3.23.18
passages.text: garrula, cum blandis dicitur hora dolis.

passages.label: Prop. 3.23.19
passages.text: me miserum, his aliquis rationem scribit avarus

passages.label: Prop. 3.23.20
passages.text: et ponit duras inter ephemeridas!

passages.label: Prop. 3.23.21
passages.text: quas si quis mihi rettulerit, donabitur auro:

passages.label: Prop. 3.23.22
passages.text: quisenta velit?

passages.label: Prop. 3.23.23
passages.text: i puer, et citus haec aliqua propone columna,

passages.label: Prop. 3.23.24
passages.text: et dominum Esquiliis scribe habitare tuum.

passages.label: Prop. 3.24.1
passages.text: Falsast ista tuae, mulier, fiducia formae,

passages.label: Prop. 3.24.2
passages.text: olim oculis nimium facta superba meis.

passages.label: Prop. 3.24.3
passages.text: noster amor talis tribuit tibi, Cynthia, laudes:

passages.label: Prop. 3.24.4
passages.text: versibus insignem te pudet esse meis.

passages.label: Prop. 3.24.5
passages.text: mixtam te varia laudavi saepe figura,

passages.label: Prop. 3.24.6
passages.text: ut, quod non esses, esse putaret amor;

passages.label: Prop. 3.24.7
passages.text: et color est totiens roseo collatus Eoo,

passages.label: Prop. 3.24.8
passages.text: cum tibi quaesitus candor in ore foret:

passages.label: Prop. 3.24.9
passages.text: quod mihi non patrii poterant avertere amici,

passages.label: Prop. 3.24.10
passages.text: eluere aut vasto Thessala saga mari,

passages.label: Prop. 3.24.11
passages.text: hoc ego—non ferro, non igne coactus, at ipsa

passages.label: Prop. 3.24.12
passages.text: naufragus Aegaea (vera fatebor) aqua.

passages.label: Prop. 3.24.13
passages.text: correptus saevo Veneris torrebar aeno;

passages.label: Prop. 3.24.14
passages.text: vinctus eram versas in mea terga manus.

passages.label: Prop. 3.24.15
passages.text: ecce coronatae portum tetigere carinae,

passages.label: Prop. 3.24.16
passages.text: traiectae Syrtes, ancora iacta mihist.

passages.label: Prop. 3.24.17
passages.text: nunc demum vasto fessi resipiscimus aestu,

passages.label: Prop. 3.24.18
passages.text: vulneraque ad sanum nunc coiere mea.

passages.label: Prop. 3.24.19
passages.text: Mens Bona, si qua dea's, tua me in sacraria dono!

passages.label: Prop. 3.24.20
passages.text: exciderunt surdo tot mea vota Iovi.

passages.label: Prop. 3.25.1
passages.text: Risus eram positis inter convivia mensis,

passages.label: Prop. 3.25.2
passages.text: et de me poterat quilibet esse loquax.

passages.label: Prop. 3.25.3
passages.text: quinque tibi potui servire fideliter annos:

passages.label: Prop. 3.25.4
passages.text: ungue meam morso saepe querere fidem.

passages.label: Prop. 3.25.5
passages.text: nil moveor lacrimis: ista sum captus ab arte;

passages.label: Prop. 3.25.6
passages.text: semper ab insidiis, Cynthia, flere soles.

passages.label: Prop. 3.25.7
passages.text: flebo ego discedens, sed fletum iniuria vincit:

passages.label: Prop. 3.25.8
passages.text: tu bene conveniens non sinis ire iugum.

passages.label: Prop. 3.25.9
passages.text: limina iam nostris valeant lacrimantia verbis,

passages.label: Prop. 3.25.10
passages.text: nec tamen irata ianua fracta manu.

passages.label: Prop. 3.25.11
passages.text: at te celatis aetas gravis urgeat annis,

passages.label: Prop. 3.25.12
passages.text: et veniat formae ruga sinistra tuae!

passages.label: Prop. 3.25.13
passages.text: vellere tum cupias albos a stirpe capillos,

passages.label: Prop. 3.25.14
passages.text: iam speculo rugas increpitante tibi,

passages.label: Prop. 3.25.15
passages.text: exclusa inque vicem fastus patiare superbos,

passages.label: Prop. 3.25.16
passages.text: et quae fecisti facta queraris anus!

passages.label: Prop. 3.25.17
passages.text: has tibi fatalis cecinit mea pagina diras:

passages.label: Prop. 3.25.18
passages.text: eventum formae disce timere tuae!
